evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies spend RPC logic in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp
rationale: Rejects duplicate inputs in `sendall` to prevent creating consensus-invalid transactions that lock UTXOs and produce negative wallet balances. As demonstrated in the reproduction, passing duplicate outpoints counts input values multiple times, commits an un-broadcastable `bad-txns-inputs-duplicate` transaction to the wallet, and corrupts `getbalances` nonmempool reporting until manually abandoned.
